verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official Embedded Payroll React SDK, a component library with built-in business logic and a first-party GitHub repo, so official SDK support exists. The evidence shows only this one front-end SDK, scoped to Embedded Payroll, and API access is restricted to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners. That limits who can build against it. missing for 10: official server-side/language SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Ruby) beyond the React component library, SDK coverage beyond Embedded Payroll, open (non-partner) access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The **[Gusto Embedded Payroll React SDK](https://sdk.gusto.com/)** offers component libraries with built-in business logic that helps our developers with the complexity of building with payroll APIs.
The Gusto API is currently restricted to [Gusto App Integration](https://gusto.com/product/integrations) and [Embedded Payroll](https://embedded.gusto.com/) partners.
